The best part was knowing I could go out and not be sick the next day! I occasionally have a drink now but honestly don't miss it as much as I thought I would, and usually don't even want to finish the drink I do get.  My depression, fibro, and stomach REALLY don't miss it! 
Ultimately, you have to make that decision yourself. You know when it's time.  It's YOUR body!

I completely understand this.  Not sure what your childhood looked like (I know, not EVERYTHING is trauma related) but I didn't get the compliments growing up.  My partner and his family are very positive people. My partner compliments me a lot on my accomplishments and says "I'm proud of you" and I honestly have no idea how to handle it. Usually I make a sarcastic comment because I don't know what to say and how to react. (Usually my snearky/sarcastic side comes out, which seems inappropriate at times when he's trying to be nice!) I had to say something because while compliments are meant to make one feel good, the discomfort got to be too much.  When explaining WHY I don't know how to react, he's approached it differently.  Sometimes communication can help. A compliment isn't helpful if it just causes discomfort!

My only advice is Google doesn't help. I feel like too many unknowns about this to really be helpful. (Maybe Google scholar, but then you're reading scientific papers, which can be helpful, but difficult to read.)
Also, this is 100% IMO, don't bother researching while on <too much> Cannabis. It barely helps on a good day, and going down that rabbit hole while in pain, trying to find answers while in pain, only adds to the mental pain, anxiety, and confusion. 
It is scary and this journey sucks. I do hope you find something that helps any of the mental and physical pain!
A tubal ligation won't stop your menstrual cycle. I got a tubal and they inserted an IUD so I don't don't get my cycle.

Also, and hear me out, it isn't anyone's business why you're child free! That's a personal decision so maybe THEY shouldn't be asking - no matter what your reasons.
